assets.title: Snow civilian, original dark-skinned game derivative
assets.author: Blender Studio
assets.evidence: Existing project character provenance in docs/source-register.md; accepted reduced game derivative fingerprinted by tools/assets/prepare_civilian_characters.mjs.
assets.changes: Reuses the original 22-joint game rig, clothing, geometry and corrected animation tracks. Textures resized to at most 512 pixels, KTX2 encoded with mipmaps; actor buffers losslessly compressed. Movement provenance is listed separately below; the run, sprint, jump and ledge-climb motion added on 2026-10-25 comes from Snow's supplied movement (see remainingSuppliedRights).

assets.title: Rain civilians, original dark-skinned derivative and lighter-skinned texture variant
assets.author: Blender Studio
assets.evidence: Existing project character provenance in docs/source-register.md; accepted reduced game derivative fingerprinted by tools/assets/prepare_civilian_characters.mjs.
assets.changes: Reuses the original 22-joint game rig, civilian clothing, geometry and corrected animation tracks. Helsinki Rides creates the lighter complexion by modifying warm skin texels while retaining dark eyebrows and neutral details. Both variants use textures at most 512 pixels, KTX2 with mipmaps and losslessly compressed actor buffers. The white Rain is a texture derivative, not a separate Blender Studio source character. The run, sprint, jump and ledge-climb motion added on 2026-10-25 comes from Snow's supplied movement (see remainingSuppliedRights).
